source_caption:
Although Rebecca Ferguson possesses a strong singing voice and has a background in music, she explicitly requested not to sing the show-stopping ballad “Never Enough” herself, recognizing that portraying the historically legendary “Swedish Nightingale” required a specific, world-class vocal caliber she felt she lacked. The soaring, powerhouse vocals were instead provided by professional singer Loren Allred. To ensure the performance looked completely authentic on screen, Ferguson spent weeks meticulously studying Allred’s breathing patterns, vocal inflections, and facial contortions during recording sessions, allowing her to flawlessly lip-sync and physicalize the emotional weight of the song while performing in front of a live audience of extras.

The Greatest Showman (2017), directed by Michael Gracey, starring Hugh Jackman, Zac Efron, Michelle Williams, Rebecca Ferguson. A highly romanticized, spectacular original musical inspired by the imagination of P.T. Barnum, celebrating the birth of show business and the visionary who rose from nothing to create a worldwide sensation.

source_details.synopsis: The Greatest Showman is a 2017 American musical period drama film directed by Michael Gracey from a screenplay by Jenny Bicks and Bill Condon, based on an original story by Bicks. The film stars Hugh Jackman, Zac Efron, Michelle Williams, Rebecca Ferguson, and Zendaya. Featuring nine original songs written by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul, and an original musical orchestral score composed by John Debney and Joseph Trapanese, the film is a heavily fictionalized depiction of the life of P. T. Barnum, a showman and entertainer who created the Barnum & Bailey Circus, and its star attractions.
